title: Umuryango Utarakurikije Umunsi w'Ikiruhuko
intro: Injira mu gace k’inyanja aho itegeko ry’Imana ryashyizeho umunsi umwe wo kuramya no kwifata. Itsinda ry’abantu muri uyu muryango bahisemo kugerageza aho iryo tegeko rigarukira bakoresheje umugambi w’uburiganya, biganisha ku mpinduka zagiye zigaragara mu bihe bitandukanye. Abo bantu ni bande, kandi ni iki cyababayeho?
clues: Twari dutuye hafi y'inkombe, aho inyanja yatuberaga ikidutunga.
Twategetswe kubaha umunsi umwe w'icyumweru, tuwushyira ku ruhande mu byo dukurikirana ku isi.
Kuri uwo munsi, ifi yaje aho turi ari nyinshi cyane, nk'aho idushuka ngo twice itegeko.
Twateguye gahunda yo gufata amafi mu mutego mu ijoro rishyira umunsi mutagatifu, hanyuma tukayakusanya nyuma yuko arangiye.
Ubwo bamwe muri twe twaburiraga ku bw'ubu buriganya, twirengagije inama zabo maze dukomeza.
Kubera ibicumuro byacu, twahinduwe nk'inkende, twasuzuguwe kandi twanzwe.
arabic: وَلَقَدْ عَلِمْتُمُ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱعْتَدَوْا۟ مِنكُمْ فِى ٱلسَّبْتِ فَقُلْنَا لَهُمْ كُونُوا۟ قِرَدَةً خَـٰسِـِٔينَ
verse: And you had already known about those who transgressed among you concerning the sabbath, and We said to them, "Be apes, despised." (2:65)
